Asha (CSM): Heads up — Mercury Labs (acct: mercury-labs) pushed a nightly reindex and their embedding spend jumped overnight. QBR prep Friday; need a short remediation + numbers for the deck.
Nikhil (FinOps): How big is the gap vs baseline?
Lena (SWE): From logs: `/api/embeds/stream` accounted for 68% of the delta. 24h delta ~260k tokens. Likely multiple workers reprocessing same doc chunks. Using sdk-js v2.0.
monitor-bot: Alert: embedding-spend-anomaly for mercury-labs — 2026-05-12T02:14:07Z — delta +259872 tokens.
Asha (CSM): Can Ops put a temporary soft cap so search remains up but prevents further runaway? Also want an action item list for the QBR slide.
Omar (CS Ops): We can apply org-level throttle: 250k tokens/day on `/api/embeds/stream` for 48h with bypass for their infra team. Will draft rule now.
Nikhil (FinOps): I'll run numbers: baseline avg embeddings = 85k/day, current 3-day avg = 210k/day, projected 30-day = ~6.3M if unchanged. If spike consumes >20% of prepaid credits, mark renewal "watch".
Lena (SWE): Quick mitigation in their code: include idempotency token per chunk and add a preflight checksum. Snippet we can share:
```
client.embeds.stream(chunks, idempotency_key=job_id)
```
Also recommend limiting parallel workers during migrations.
Asha (CSM): Great. Action items:
- Omar: apply throttle + enable infra bypass (ETA 20m)
- Lena: PR a short SDK note + onboarding checklist snippet (ETA 24h)
- Nikhil: draft credit remediation and renewal note for QBR (ETA tomorrow)
- Asha: update QBR slide and customer note (ETA EOD)
Omar (CS Ops): Throttle applied: org mercury-labs `/api/embeds/stream` capped at 250k tokens/day — active 2026-05-12T02:34:18Z.
Asha (CSM): Thanks — I'll pull the raw numbers into the slide and call out "reindex ripples" and our recommended fixes. Will add a customer enablement invite to walk dedupe + batching.
Nikhil (FinOps): Once throttle metrics show reduction, I'll compute avoided spend and include a proposed credit adjustment in the QBR.
Asha (CSM): Leaving thread open until QBR deck and postmortem attached. Ping here for any new spikes.
